versions.changelog:
Meta Ads Analytics & Event Finder 1.0.0 initial release:

- Provides ad performance reporting (spend, conversions, CAC), organized by ad set.
- Supports natural language date ranges in analytics queries.
- Includes an event finder tool to list all active event names for accurate conversion tracking.
- Guides on required configuration and how to obtain Meta Ads credentials.
- Example commands and troubleshooting tips included for easy onboarding.
